written: 2026-11-24, before any old-patch scan (Lightning Conduit alone was seen in a compatibility test: 1.4 is not blind)
rules: A case is FOUND when the named detector, at its default thresholds, on that patch's PoB, flags one of its hit pieces.
condition = condition_scan.payoffs(); matrix = matrix_scan.outliers(); no tuning after seeing results (a tuned re-run is a separate column).
False alarm = a flagged row whose piece was not cut by the next major patch (notes checked per flagged row).
Bar (agreed 2026-11-23): at least half of the calculable cases found, at most one false alarm per real find.
Cases PoB can't calculate (D, E, F, G, J) are listed but scored separately: they are what Lodestone does not cover yet.

cases.name: Archmage mana stacking
cases.note: Archmage is a spirit skill, so the matrix (uniques, keystones) may not see it

cases.name: Lightning Spear + Tangletongue
cases.note: Tangletongue is a weapon unique: the matrix skips weapon uniques, expected miss

cases.name: Totem Archmage (Ancestral Bond)
cases.note: the break was a cost going to zero (totem casts paid no mana); PoB's DPS may not show a cost, so a miss is possible even if the scan works

cases.name: Uhtred supports counting Meta gems
cases.note: lineage support gems: the matrix scans uniques and keystones, not supports, so this case was never testable (like Rathpith in 3.2)
